title: Woman Shoots Husband Then Changes Her Story
description:
Bodycam footage captures the chaotic aftermath of a deadly shooting in Coweta County, Georgia, after Cheryl Howell Coe reported that her husband had been shot during a late-night disturbance. Coe initially claimed she mistook her husband, Luther “Luke” Lee Coe III, for an intruder and fired out of fear. Following a weeklong trial in August 2025, a jury found Cheryl Howell Coe guilty of malice murder, felony murder, and aggravated assault. She was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. Watch the full investigation unfold in this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
